from collections import Counter

def print_next_greater_freq(arr, n):
    freq = Counter(arr)
    result = []
    stack = []
    
    for i in range(n-1, -1, -1):
        while stack and freq[arr[stack[-1]]] <= freq[arr[i]]:
            stack.pop()
        result.append(-1 if not stack else arr[stack[-1]])
        stack.append(i)
    
    return result[::-1]

# Example usage:
